en.headline: Woman arrested over suspected child abuse after dashcam video circulates
en.dek: A 44-year-old was arrested in Western district on Friday after footage appeared to show a boy being shoved into a roadside railing in Wan Chai.
body: Police have arrested a 44-year-old woman on suspicion of child abuse after a widely circulated dashcam video appeared to show her shoving a boy into a metal roadside railing in Wan Chai.
A police spokesman said the woman was arrested on Friday afternoon in Western district after the footage came to the force’s attention. The case is being investigated by Wan Chai officers.

In the video, the woman is seen getting out of a private car at a section of Wan Chai Road near Burrows Street, with a boy following. She then turns, holds the boy by the waist, and the pair move toward the pavement.
Police have not released further details of the boy’s condition or the relationship between the woman and the child. The investigation continues.

zh.headline: 灣仔行車記錄片段傳出後 女事主涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 一名44歲女子周五下午在西區被捕，警方指與一段疑似將男童推向路邊欄杆的行車記錄片段有關。
body: 警方表示，一名44歲女子因涉嫌虐兒於周五下午在西區被捕，案件由灣仔警區跟進。
事緣一段廣為流傳的行車記錄片段，顯示一名女子在灣仔道近巴路士街一段，疑似將一名男童推向路邊金屬欄杆。
片段中，該女子從私家車下車，男童隨後跟上，女子轉身抱住男童腰部，兩人再走向行人路。
警方暫未公布男童傷勢或與涉案女子的關係，案件仍在調查中。
